questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From 00:09 to 00:12, the board is fully visible and clearly holds three pens arranged in a row.
The left and right pens have their black caps/ends at the bottom, while the middle pen has its black cap/end at the top, indicating it is flipped relative to the others.
All three pens have clear barrels and black caps/ends, appearing identical in color.
All three pens appear to have a black cap on one end; none show an exposed tip without a corresponding cap on the other end (assuming standard capped pens).
The board moves continuously from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the white board as it slides.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is oriented with its cap/end pointing up, while the left and right pens are oriented with their caps/ends pointing down. This violates the condition that all pens must point the same direction.

description: One pen is flipped 180 degrees relative to the other two.
